output_list.criticism: The 'distributeFUD' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The 'totalSupply' property is involved in a mathematical operation (subtraction), and if it reaches a minimum value, an overflow occurs, breaking the value. Attackers can inflate the 'totalSupply' of the token's balance of an attacker's account to a very large value.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The 'balances[_to] += _value' statement can cause a overflow if '_value' is at a maximum and 'balances[_to]' tries to add it, causing balances[_to] to wrap around and become 0. Outputting a bool value.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The 'balances[_to] += _value' statement can cause a overflow if '_value' is at a maximum and 'balances[_to]' tries to add it, causing balances[_to] to wrap around and become 0. Outputting a bool value.

The 'output_list' function has an access control vulnerability. It is intended to output a list of functions and their vulnerability descriptions, but it is owned by attackers, allowing them to manipulate the output content.

The 'distributeFUD' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The 'totalSupply' property is involved in a mathematical operation (subtraction), and if it reaches a minimum value, an overflow occurs, breaking the value. Attackers can inflate the 'totalSupply' of the token's balance of an attacker's account to a very large value.
